description: This file is a Makefile for building U-Boot firmware, containing build rules, configuration, and dependency checks.

methods.name: Package/u-boot/install/default
methods.description: Defines default installation procedure for u-boot package, copying the u-boot image to the target directory.

methods.name: U-Boot/Init
methods.description: Initializes U-Boot build parameters such as target, subtarget, devices, name, dependencies, and image name.

methods.name: Build/Configure/U-Boot
methods.description: Configures the U-Boot build environment by running make with appropriate variables and optional custom configuration.

methods.name: Build/Compile/U-Boot
methods.description: Compiles U-Boot using make with cross-compile and optional device tree compiler.
